budget_profile.purpose: resolve, download, hash and import-check a Python distribution. The default for every python_package entry.
budget_profile.network: ALLOWED -- this is the explicit acquisition stage
budget_profile.rationale: 512 MiB covers the largest named wheel by ~30x (z3_solver win_amd64 is 16.9 MiB) plus a full transitive closure. 15 minutes covers a cold resolve on a slow link. 2 GiB RSS is 15 percent of available RAM, so two light probes can run beside each other and beside the engine.
budget_profile.name: light_probe

resource_receipt.network_policy: ALLOWED -- this is the explicit acquisition stage
resource_receipt.rss_enforcement: NOT ENFORCED -- no job object / cgroup cap. peak_rss_bytes_os_counter is the OS peak-working-set counter for this process and IS reliable; rss_ceiling_exceeded_during_sampling is sampled and can miss a spike. Neither stops a step.
resource_receipt.rss_excludes_children: This is THIS process only. pip, git and venv run as children and their RSS is NOT included.
